chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy b
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** Evil itself, the selfhood opposed to the Divine, has received three decisive defeats through three stages of spiritual combat; and at each stage, divine wisdom inflicted upon it progressively greater ruin.

**¶2:** In the first stage: evil was drawn forth from concealment into the open field of awareness, and severed from its ground in the unregenerate natural mind, out of which it had arisen. It was overcome in that first combat, seized and [GAP-1] restrained by the Divine Life dwelling within interior truths.

**¶3:** The second defeat is the stage in which evil is disintegrated and consumed, and it perishes in the fire of divine love. It is destroyed and overthrown — separated from all the false appearances and phantasies through which alone it has existence. And it will be gathered back [GAP-2] into a constraint corresponding to its original nature, and reduced to the impotent state it occupied before it ever rose to act.

**¶4:** The third defeat that will befall evil is the final reversal [GAP-3] at the ultimate judgment, when everything will be separated, and the intellectual element of evil will be divided [GAP-4] from its volitional element. Now, the false reasoning will be confined within a dense and inert mass, but the evil affection [GAP-5] will be cast into permanent spiritual death. For the two will be sundered [GAP-6] by an immovable divine truth set between them, throughout all states upon states, in perpetuity.

**¶5:** This is the manner in which the permanent restraint of evil will be accomplished — in a bond that is absolute and irrevocable, one from which there is no release — because [GAP-7] the powers of divine order have accomplished its binding, and it is bound forever. And they have accomplished its complete isolation, and it remains isolated in perpetuity.

---
*Note on ¶4:* The separation of "male" from "female" within evil corresponds precisely to the Swedenborgian principle that falsity (understanding) and evil (will) can be forcibly disjoined so that neither can any longer animate the other — this is the essence of the "eternal fetter."

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Darkness itself, the Enemy, has received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the Light in those three wars.
The first: (The Enemy) was brought out to the middle and separated from his dark earth, whence he had departed. He was vanquished in that first war, caught and [bound] by the Living Soul.

The second blow is the time when he will be dissolved and melted, and he perishes in this great fire. He is destroyed and overthrown, from the images that are all by which he exists. And he will be gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype, and be made like he was from the first beginning.

The third blow that will befall the Enemy is the 'rolling back' [at the] end when everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female. Now, the male will be bound in the lump, but the female [will be thrown] in to the tomb. For it will be divided [by a great] stone in their midst, for generation upon generation, for ever and ever.

This is the way that the binding of the Enemy will come about, in a fetter that is burdensome and strong, one from which there is never escape; because [they have achieved] his binding and bound him for ever. And they have achieved his being set apart, and he has been set apart for ever.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "restrained," and "bound" is the exact natural-register term for restraint of evil in the Kephalaia's vocabulary; "caught and bound" is a standard pairing in Manichaean cosmological texts describing the defeat of the Enemy.

The spiritual reading says "gathered back into a constraint," and "gathered in to the fetter" (= gathered into the fetter) is the exact grammatical construction needed to express being returned into a bond corresponding to its archetype.
The spiritual reading says "at the ultimate judgment," and "at the end" is the standard Kephalaia temporal phrase for the final eschatological moment; "at the" is the only natural preposition here.

The spiritual reading says "divided from its volitional element," and "divided from" is the standard construction for separation in both Coptic and English renderings of the Kephalaia; male divided from female expresses falsity sundered from evil will.

The spiritual reading says "will be cast into permanent spiritual death," and "will be thrown in to the tomb" is the natural-plane equivalent — casting into a tomb corresponds to consignment to spiritual death; "thrown" matches "cast" precisely.

The spiritual reading says "sundered by an immovable divine truth set between them," and the natural-plane equivalent is "divided by a great stone in their midst" — the great stone corresponds to fundamental divine truth acting as a permanent barrier between falsity and evil.

The spiritual reading says "the powers of divine order have accomplished," and "they have achieved" is the correct natural-register rendering — "they" refers to the divine powers, and "achieved" parallels the repeated formula "achieved his binding / achieved his being set apart" that structures the closing parallelism of ¶5.
